title: Great!
text: Great!. I love these wine corks here at River Run Rustic Wood Crafts they are used in a lot of different ways. Jewelry hangers and wine cork trivets primarily. But they could be used in many ways, picture frames, note boards and whatever craft project you can think of. I will say they have words on them and they are repetitive, a lot of the same words and sayings. But they are nice. I mix them in with regular wine corks from wine bottles too.

product_metadata.title: Pro Grade - Wine Corks - 100 Ea. Craft Grade Wine Corks
features: Our wine corks for crafting are great for making custom creations for your home, friends, and family.
The corks feature fun words & phrases for displaying special messages or quotes in your art piece.
Enhance your home with decorative wine cork creations: coasters, trivets, signs, wreaths, and more.
Our 100% natural corks for crafts are non-toxic, biodegradable, and easy to use for any project.
Bulk pack includes 100 premium craft-grade 1.75" wine bottle corks for creating art & decor.
description: Tap into your artistic talents and create beautiful decor and art with Craft-Grade Wine Corks from Pro Grade. Made of 100% natural cork bark and individually printed with words and phrases like ""life,"" ""love,"" and ""drink,"" these corks allow you to easily create a meaningful work of art for your home, a friend, or loved one. These corks are: ✅ Safe and non-toxic ✅ Brand new ✅ Not recycled or repurposed ✅ All a uniform 1.75"" size They are ideal for creating an all-cork masterpiece or enhancing any art project. Use them to make: ✅ Wine coasters ✅ Trivets ✅ Decorative signs and more. The light and airy look and feel of cork bark accents any space with a soft, rustic vibe, effortlessly blending with any home or office interior. This value bulk pack includes 100 premium craft-grade 1.75"" wine corks.
